verdict.rationale: Steel supplies on-demand cloud browser sessions (steel-docs-1) and integrations where external frameworks like the Claude Agent SDK or AgentKit run the agent loop (steel-docs-9, steel-docs-38). These are developer building blocks for constructing automations. There is no evidence that Steel itself lets a user set up automations that run autonomously in the background, such as scheduled, recurring, or triggered jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
